info.name: Message Broker
info.description: Complete Postman test suite for the Message Broker (Tasks 1 through 7): Log Downloads, Service-to-Service Relay, Load Balancing & Circuit Breakers, Subscriber Queues, Topic Queues & GET /topics, Thread-per-Request, gRPC, Durable Queues & Dead Letter Channel (GET /dead-letters), and High Availability & Prometheus Monitoring.
